en.title: Array Alternating Between Maximum and Minimum
en.description:
Output all array elements in the order largest, smallest, second largest, second smallest, and so on, keeping duplicates and using each input element exactly once.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the array. 2≤n≤100000, −10^6≤element≤10^6, and duplicates are allowed.
en.output: Output n elements arranged in alternating maximum-minimum order.
hints: After sorting, use two pointers to alternately take the largest at the right end and the smallest at the left end until they meet.
